note: The platform's roles and what each may do. Written by hand (not generated); loaded at migrate time into roles, permissions and role_permissions.

permissions.description: See the console: the overview, clients, staff, demo requests and the audit log
Configure a client's agents, supply-chain profile, channels and rules
Remind distributors and ask for stock exports
Invite a client's people, renew invitations, change their access, deactivate them
Change a client's plan and take it live

roles.name: Super admin
roles.description: Everything, including plans, going live and the platform's own staff

roles.name: Platform engineer
roles.description: Sets clients up and configures them; not plans, going live or staff

roles.name: Support
roles.description: Helps clients day to day: their setup, people and distributors; not plans, going live or staff

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Approves the plans the agents make, with the money on screen

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Runs the workspace: sign-in, people, guardrails, integrations, the audit log

roles.name: Member
roles.description: The client's own staff: sees the batches, the money and the reports

roles.name: Partner
roles.description: Distributors, kiranas and food banks the client invites
